submission.natural_language_explanation: L1/N400+ is a word-form detector: it reads a token's surface string, not the word's meaning or grammatical role (token identity explains 57% of its activation variance, position 1%), and it fires on the open-class lexicon of physical specification - lowercase colour terms (green, gray/grey, blue, brown, yellow, red, black, orange, purple, pink, cream), part and geometry nouns (side, centre/center, corner, bottom, left, rim, band, bars, sheet, wall, pieces, halves, branches, bodies, elements, divisions), material, ingredient and measure forms (juice, paste, straw, cord, salt, olive, ice, light, heat, hours, minutes, days, weeks, months, years, degrees, teaspoons, calories, temperature, intensity, '°') and specification/metadata words (option, optional, Details, description, mode, condition, status, errors, labels, stages, margin), plus the procedural particles 'then' and 'off' and the mid-word BPE continuations and non-Latin characters that carry those strings ('ays' in bays/days, 'IDTH' in width, 'ney' in chimney, 'ener' in gardener, 'ison', and single CJK/kana/Cyrillic/Arabic/Thai characters). Membership is by form, not sense: the same form fires in transferred, technical or abstract uses - 'centre' as a verb 0.84 and as a noun 0.84, 'degrees' as academic awards 1.15 and for oven heat 1.46, 'pieces' as musical works 1.24, 'number' in an inventory 1.27, 'green' for 'inexperienced' 0.71 - so no claim is made that a listed form stays quiet in another sense or role; strength is graded by the form and by its neighbours and some occurrences fall below the line ('side' as a verb 0.09, 'bodies' as organisations 0.25, 'bowl' 0.43), and no upcoming token is prepared (the Jacobian lens promotes only replacement-character fragments, kurtosis 43, agreement 20%), so the reading is retrospective. At exactly zero is the determiner/pronoun/auxiliary core (0 of 8,706 determiners active in the scan, and 'the', 'a', 'an', 'and', 'to', 'is', 'are', 'for', 'which', 'who', 'each', 'same' measure 0.00 in every probe); the relational/analytic lexicon (idea, ideas, problem, policy, company, cost, price, work, people, plan, reason, method, theory, argument, question, answer, result, cause, process, knowledge, meaning, purpose, decision, item, detail, example, issue, point, fact, change, difference, relationship, importance, need, help, role) never appears among the scan's 200 highest-mean tokens (cut-off 0.566), and 19 of the 20 abstract sentences I built around it peak at 0.00-0.29 (the exception fires on ' them', not on one of these nouns); class membership is form-specific rather than semantic, so plain object and attribute words that look like class members stay low ('surface', 'cover', 'handle', 'top', 'front', 'inner', 'outer', 'middle', 'panel', 'percent', 'inches', 'meters', 'miles', 'degree', 'table', 'room', 'door', 'tree', 'book', 'map', 'paper', 'water', 'fire', 'rain', 'iron', 'carpet', 'computer' at 0.0-0.55) and so do unobserved colour words ('teal', 'plum', 'slate', 'rose', 'beige' all 0.44). A probe containing at least one listed form is predicted active; a probe of closed-class or relational/analytic text is predicted inactive, but function forms outside the determiner core are not perfectly silent (the scan's POS profile has 125 of 10,566 prepositions and 189 of 11,504 verbs active, about 1-2%, and 'before' and 'than' fire in a minority of their occurrences), so a short probe built only from such forms is not guaranteed negative.

rival_explanations: Register rival: the pole tracks the topic rather than the form, firing on passages that describe a physical object or procedure and staying quiet when a listed word is used abstractly, so 'centre' as a verb, 'degrees' as academic awards, 'pieces' as musical works and 'number' in an inventory should be quiet while concrete description with none of the listed forms should fire.

Two-token-unit rival: the pole marks the second element of a pair - a head noun after a content-word modifier or a BPE continuation after a fragment - so a listed form after a determiner or auxiliary should stay weak ('the number' 0.30, 'several pieces' 0.43) while the same form after a numeral or content word fires ('serial number' 1.27, 'three pieces' 1.24).

Subword and script rival: the pole is a mid-word-continuation and non-Latin-character detector whose English content words are just those whose pieces recur in that role, so a word-initial English trigger should be weaker than the same string inside a longer word and text in CJK, Cyrillic, Arabic or Thai script should fire throughout.

# American Institute of Mathematical Sciences

March  2007, 2(1): 181-192. doi: 10.3934/nhm.2007.2.181

## Multiscale stochastic homogenization of monotone operators

 1 Department of Computational Mathematics, Chalmers University, SE-412 96 Göteborg, Sweden

Received  February 2006 Revised  September 2006 Published  December 2006

Multiscale stochastic homogenization is studied for divergence structure parabolic problems. More specifically we consider the asymptotic behaviour of a sequence of realizations of the form
$\frac{\partial u^\omega_\varepsilon}{\partial t}-$div$(a(T_1(\frac{x}{\varepsilon_1})\omega_1, T_2(\frac{x}{\varepsilon_2})\omega_2 ,t, D u^\omega_\varepsilon))=f.$
It is shown, under certain structure assumptions on the random map $a(\omega_1,\omega_2,t,\xi)$, that the sequence $\{u^\omega_\e}$ of solutions converges weakly in $L^p(0,T;W^{1,p}_0(\Omega))$ to the solution $u$ of the homogenized problem $\frac{\partial u}{\partial t} -$div$( b( t,D u )) = f$.

Share the beauty, pick and share some flowers.

1) My Parents who are always quick to lend a hand when I need it the most.

2) The youth in our Ward for sharing the Christmas Spirit last night as they came through our neighborhood on their hay ride singing Christmas carols. Fun, fun!

From the Camera:

From the Heart:

In keeping with our theme, here is another random act of kindness idea.

Share the beauty of nature with a loved one by picking a special bouquet of flowers for them. The fact that you picked out the flowers yourself with them in mind will add a lot of meaning to this gift, rather than just sending store-bought flowers. This is a great activity whether you are an adult or child, and what better way to show someone how much you love them!

Benefits:

When you pick your own flowers you get to enjoy nature along the way! Take a nice long walk or hike and select your favorite flowers. Fresh air and exercise will help raise your mood. And the best part--hand picked flowers are free!

From the Spirit:

When our Heavenly Father wanted to save the world, He didn’t take over a country or develop a militia. He sent a helpless child to a choice and worthy woman and a humble and believing man living in insecure circumstances in a conquered land occupied by a hostile force. The harsh geopolitical and military circumstances of Christ’s birth should remind us that Heavenly Father can bless us even if the external circumstances of our lives aren’t necessarily easy or peaceful.

A probe containing at least one listed form is predicted active; a probe of closed-class or relational/analytic text is predicted inactive, but function forms outside the determiner core are not perfectly silent (the scan's POS profile has 125 of 10,566 prepositions and 189 of 11,504 verbs active, about 1-2%, and 'before' and 'than' fire in a minority of their occurrences), so a short probe built only from such forms is not guaranteed negative.

Register rival: the pole tracks the topic rather than the form, firing on passages that describe a physical object or procedure and staying quiet when a listed word is used abstractly, so 'centre' as a verb, 'degrees' as academic awards, 'pieces' as musical works and 'number' in an inventory should be quiet while concrete description with none of the listed forms should fire.

Two-token-unit rival: the pole marks the second element of a pair - a head noun after a content-word modifier or a BPE continuation after a fragment - so a listed form after a determiner or auxiliary should stay weak ('the number' 0.30, 'several pieces' 0.43) while the same form after a numeral or content word fires ('serial number' 1.27, 'three pieces' 1.24).

Subword and script rival: the pole is a mid-word-continuation and non-Latin-character detector whose English content words are just those whose pieces recur in that role, so a word-initial English trigger should be weaker than the same string inside a longer word and text in CJK, Cyrillic, Arabic or Thai script should fire throughout.

verdict.notes: hard_negative: 11/20 passed; positive_holdout: 7/10 passed; counterfactual: 8/8 passed; lookahead_consistency: 1/1 passed. Failed gates: specificity.
